alerts.reason: September net sales grew 3.8% year over year, and firm early-quarter volume demand supports a forecast that December stays above −5% (A, B). Excess supply had begun to depress chicken prices as August cold-storage inventories rose 4.3% (C). I expect that pricing pressure to build enough for consolidated net sales to fall at least 5% year over year in the quarter beginning December 29.

Power Products distribution offset weaker Materials demand in September, lifting revenue 1.08% year over year (A). I expect that offset to keep December above −5%, but softening product demand and continued price pressure in some applications (B) put both volume and selling prices at risk. I forecast a year-over-year revenue decline of at least 5% in the quarter beginning December 29.
